intro: Kun Khmer kickboxing and football are popular in Cambodia, which hosted the SEA Games for the first time in 2023.

chapters.title: Kun Khmer
text: Kun Khmer is a traditional martial art using fists, elbows, knees and kicks, shown in Angkor carvings.

chapters.title: Events
text: Cambodia hosted the 2023 SEA Games at the new Morodok Techo stadium. Sorn Seavmey won Cambodia's first Asian Games gold in taekwondo in 2014.
